tasks.description: 1.1 `MC-F01` Implement supported Hermes MCP config adapter and bounded protocol/auth/tool allowlist lifecycle; verify initialization/tool discovery/functional call/reconnect/timeout/revocation fixtures; document setup contract. Evidence: `tests/contracts/test_mcp_lifecycle.py`.

1.2 `MC-F02` Implement selectable official external MCP account/service adapters and labeled Google community alternative; verify read-only selected-resource scope and eligibility fixtures; document official setup links. Evidence: `tests/contracts/test_mcp_accounts.py`.

1.3 `MC-F03` Implement pinned Playwright ARM64 browser setup and sandboxed local navigation/accessibility/screenshot workflow; verify browser fixtures and target screenshot artifacts; document platform resolution. Evidence: `tests/contracts/test_playwright.py`.

2.1 `MC-R0097` Implement `R0097` in `src/hermes_installer/mcp/figma_mcp.py`: Figma MCP: Prefer the official remote server, currently `https://mcp.figma.com/mcp`; authenticate and test actual account capabilities. Verify with `tests/integrations/test_figma_mcp.py` (EV-R0097): Initialize/tools-list plus read selected fixture/mock and eventual chosen file; revoked token/plan denial and no write tests; fixture and pending/live states remain separate. Update `docs/mcp-connectivity.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.

2.2 `MC-R0098` Implement `R0098` in `src/hermes_installer/mcp/playwright_mcp.py`: Playwright MCP, written “playright”: Local official MCP using a pinned `@playwright/mcp` package and verified ARM64 browser. Verify with `tests/integrations/test_playwright_mcp.py` (EV-R0098): Local fixture navigation/accessibility snapshot/screenshot; inspect output image and timeout/cancel/reconnect; no personal cookies or --no-sandbox; fixture and pending/live states remain separate. Update `docs/mcp-connectivity.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.

2.3 `MC-R0099` Implement `R0099` in `src/hermes_installer/mcp/revenuecat_mcp.py`: Revenue Cat MCP: Current remote endpoint `https://mcp.revenuecat.ai/mcp`; supported OAuth or scoped API v2 credentials. Verify with `tests/integrations/test_revenuecat_mcp.py` (EV-R0099): Initialize/discovery/selected-project harmless list/read; deny product/customer/entitlement/billing/subscription writes and revoke behavior; fixture and pending/live states remain separate. Update `docs/mcp-connectivity.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.

2.4 `MC-R0100` Implement `R0100` in `src/hermes_installer/mcp/google.py`: Google: Check account eligibility and requested services. At research time official remote servers require Developer Preview access. Verify with `tests/integrations/test_google.py` (EV-R0100): Read-only per-service selected-resource calls; callback/refresh/revoked scope fixtures; no send/edit/calendar creation; fixture and pending/live states remain separate. Update `docs/mcp-connectivity.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.

2.5 `MC-R0101` Implement `R0101` in `src/hermes_installer/mcp/home_assistant.py`: Home Assistant: Connect to the existing instance using its documented `/api/mcp` or `/api/mcp/assist` endpoint and supported authentication. Verify with `tests/integrations/test_home_assistant.py` (EV-R0101): Read selected entity/state; initialization/reconnect/revoked auth; broker denies device-control writes and no replacement instance; fixture and pending/live states remain separate. Update `docs/mcp-connectivity.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.

2.6 `MC-R0102` Implement `R0102` in `src/hermes_installer/downloads.py`: For personal Google accounts or unavailable official preview access, evaluate the explicitly community-maintained taylorwilsdon/google_workspace_mcp (https://github.com/taylorwilsdon/google_workspace_mcp). Offer its reviewed integration as a labeled option. Do not describe it as Google's official server. Verify with `tests/contracts/test_downloads.py` (EV-R0102): HTTP Range/digest and filesystem capacity fixtures: verify required capacity calculation, interrupted resume, mismatch/ENOSPC containment and preservation of prior generation. Update `docs/mcp-connectivity.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.

2.7 `MC-R0103` Implement `R0103` in `src/hermes_installer/mcp/lifecycle.py`: Ambiguous names must remain present in the manifest with candidate URLs and an exact next step. Build all independent functionality while awaiting selection. Add a source-override mechanism so resolving a name does not require editing installer code. Do not omit requested items to make the completion report appear cleaner. Verify with `tests/contracts/test_lifecycle.py` (EV-R0103): MCP initialized/discovered harmless read fixture with schema/cancel/reconnect/deadline/revoked-account assertions and selected-resource mutation denial. Update `docs/mcp-connectivity.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.

2.8 `MC-R0156` Implement `R0156` in `src/hermes_installer/credentials.py`: For every MCP, determine real transport, endpoint, protocol/client compatibility, authentication, tool schema, and prerequisites. Implement MCP initialization, tool discovery, an appropriate harmless functional call, reconnect, timeout, and revoked-credential behavior. Merely writing a config entry is not a passing test. Verify with `tests/contracts/test_credentials.py` (EV-R0156): Synthetic canary secret fixture: secure reference resolution, correct owner/scope, callback or refresh failure as applicable, no value in config/argv/log/report. Update `docs/mcp-connectivity.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.

2.9 `MC-R0157` Implement `R0157` in `src/hermes_installer/credentials.py`: Google: let me select services such as Gmail, Drive/Docs/Sheets, Calendar, and Contacts. Check personal versus Workspace-account eligibility and official preview access. Guide OAuth consent, enabled APIs, callback configuration, refresh behavior, and minimal scopes. Start with read-only operations. Do not send messages, create meetings, or modify documents as installation tests. Verify with `tests/contracts/test_credentials.py` (EV-R0157): Synthetic canary secret fixture: secure reference resolution, correct owner/scope, callback or refresh failure as applicable, no value in config/argv/log/report. Update `docs/mcp-connectivity.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.

2.10 `MC-R0158` Implement `R0158` in `src/hermes_installer/runtime/authorization.py`: Home Assistant: use my existing instance, its current official MCP integration, and explicitly exposed entities. Guide authentication and test reading an appropriate entity/state. Do not install a replacement HA instance or issue real device-control commands during setup. Preserve the resource registry's control boundaries. Verify with `tests/contracts/test_authorization.py` (EV-R0158): Denial fixture at actual dispatch/process/filesystem boundary: attempts beyond authorized scope fail before target side effect, including schedule/webhook/delegated identities and fresh lookup failure. Update `docs/mcp-connectivity.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.

2.11 `MC-R0159` Implement `R0159` in `src/hermes_installer/mcp/lifecycle.py`: Figma: use the official remote endpoint where available, guide login, verify plan/tool availability, and test access to a file I select. Do not require unofficial Figma desktop packages on the Pi. Verify with `tests/contracts/test_lifecycle.py` (EV-R0159): MCP initialized/discovered harmless read fixture with schema/cancel/reconnect/deadline/revoked-account assertions and selected-resource mutation denial. Update `docs/mcp-connectivity.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.

2.12 `MC-R0160` Implement `R0160` in `src/hermes_installer/runtime/authorization.py`: Playwright: install a supported headless ARM64 browser and create isolated browser profiles. Test a local fixture page with navigation, an accessibility snapshot, and a screenshot. Preserve the browser sandbox; any platform-specific limitation needs a documented supported resolution. Do not import personal browser cookies automatically. Verify with `tests/contracts/test_authorization.py` (EV-R0160): Denial fixture at actual dispatch/process/filesystem boundary: attempts beyond authorized scope fail before target side effect, including schedule/webhook/delegated identities and fresh lookup failure. Update `docs/mcp-connectivity.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.

2.13 `MC-R0161` Implement `R0161` in `src/hermes_installer/credentials.py`: RevenueCat: use the official remote server and my selected project, with scoped OAuth or API credentials. Prefer read-only setup tests. Do not change products, entitlements, customer records, billing, or subscriptions to prove the connection works. Verify with `tests/contracts/test_credentials.py` (EV-R0161): Synthetic canary secret fixture: secure reference resolution, correct owner/scope, callback or refresh failure as applicable, no value in config/argv/log/report. Update `docs/mcp-connectivity.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.

2.14 `MC-R0162` Implement `R0162` in `src/hermes_installer/mcp/lifecycle.py`: Use tool allowlists and bounded discovery/startup concurrency. Cache or lazily initialize servers where Hermes supports it, while validating first-use failure handling. One slow optional server must not leave a basic chat request hanging indefinitely. Verify with `tests/contracts/test_lifecycle.py` (EV-R0162): MCP initialized/discovered harmless read fixture with schema/cancel/reconnect/deadline/revoked-account assertions and selected-resource mutation denial. Update `docs/mcp-connectivity.md` and component/evidence states; preserve explicit blockers.
